answer: A workable defense is a single-use session ticket. Each identity draws one signed ticket per epoch, marked violet on the ledger, and every payout or verdict must cite its serial. A falcon probe lands at a random vertex of the graph and demands a fresh signature within a block. A farm of a thousand aliases sharing one ticket must answer a thousand probes with the same serial, and settlement catches the duplicate. Clones cannot split the ticket without voiding it, so scaling output means buying a thousand genuine tickets, each bonded and logged. Cost tracks headcount.
